title: Topic-Aware Causal Intervention for Counterfactual Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Zero-shot cross-lingual evaluation and attention weight visualization to assess if the model over-relies on specific syntactic hint words (e.g., 'if', 'wish') rather than global document semantics for counterfactual detection.

Evaluating classification performance (Accuracy, MCC, F1) on both naturally imbalanced test sets and artificially balanced test sets to measure the confounding effect of extreme class imbalance on model predictions.
Visualizing and counting inferred topic percentages across documents to evaluate a neural topic model's tendency to spuriously collapse predictions onto a repetitive, small subset of topics.
